name: goal-flow
description: Plan, execute, verify, and deliver long software tasks with evidence-backed gates.

interface.shortDescription: Lean task harnesses with safe escalation
interface.longDescription: A lightweight Codex-native workflow that keeps micro and standard tasks lean, escalates high-risk work to explicit approvals and evidence-backed gates, and retains behavior traceability for meaningful changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $goal-flow to classify this task, choose the smallest safe harness, plan, execute, verify, and deliver it reliably.
